members.name: UN Country Boundaries of the World
members.description: Official country boundaries of the world as maintained by the United Nations Cartographic Section, providing the most up-to-date international boundary information for policy and analysis purposes.

info.name: Background
info.content: The UN maintains this authoritative dataset of international boundaries for official use in mapping, analysis, and policy work. These boundaries reflect the most current understanding of international borders as recognized by the UN system.

info.name: Data Source
info.content: United Nations Cartographic Section, Department of Field Support, maintained as an ArcGIS MapServer service.

info.name: Update Frequency
info.content: Regularly updated to reflect changes in international boundaries and administrative arrangements.

info.name: Service Type
info.content: Dynamic ArcGIS MapServer service providing real-time access to current boundary data

info.name: Applications
info.content: Transboundary river basin analysis, international water resource management, policy mapping, regional cooperation studies, and official UN reporting.

info.name: Legal Disclaimer
info.content: The boundaries shown do not imply official endorsement or acceptance by the United Nations. For official boundary information, consult the UN Cartographic Section.
